chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
It is a disgrace for a man of dignity to spend the night away from his home in the city where his family resides.

key_terms.بِالْمِصْرِ: in the city or settled town
key_terms.بِذَوِي الْمُرُوءَةِ: for people of dignity, honor, and upright conduct
key_terms.هُلْكٌ: disgrace, ruin, or a blameworthy state

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teach about a man spending the night away from his family while in the same city?
ai.summary: The hadith teaches a matter of muru'ah, dignified conduct, emphasizing that a man should not neglect staying with his family while being in the same city. It highlights honorable social behavior and attentiveness to one's household.
